description: This Java class defines a ShoppingCartItem entity for an e-commerce application, representing items within a user's shopping cart, including attributes such as product information, quantity, pricing, and associations to other entities.

classes.name: ShoppingCartItem
classes.description: Entity class representing an item in a shopping cart, with fields for product details, quantity, pricing, attributes, and audit information.

methods.name: ShoppingCartItem
methods.description: Constructors for initializing a ShoppingCartItem with shopping cart and product, or just product.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Returns the audit section containing audit-related info.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit section info.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the cart item.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the cart item.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Replaces the current attribute set with the provided set.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns the set of attributes associated with this cart item.

methods.name: setItemPrice
methods.description: Sets the final price of the item including rebates.

methods.name: getItemPrice
methods.description: Retrieves the final item price.

methods.name: setQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity of the product in the cart item.

methods.name: getQuantity
methods.description: Gets the quantity of the product.

methods.name: getShoppingCart
methods.description: Returns the shopping cart this item belongs to.

methods.name: setShoppingCart
methods.description: Associates the item with a shopping cart.

methods.name: setProductId
methods.description: Sets the product's ID.

methods.name: getProductId
methods.description: Retrieves the product's ID.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Sets the product object.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Gets the product object.

methods.name: addAttributes
methods.description: Adds an attribute item to this cart item.

methods.name: removeAttributes
methods.description: Removes a specific attribute item.

methods.name: removeAllAttributes
methods.description: Removes all attributes associated with this cart item.

methods.name: setSubTotal
methods.description: Sets the subtotal price for this item.

methods.name: getSubTotal
methods.description: Gets the subtotal price.

methods.name: setFinalPrice
methods.description: Sets the final price details including rebates.

methods.name: getFinalPrice
methods.description: Obtains the final price details.

methods.name: isObsolete
methods.description: Checks if this item is marked obsolete.

methods.name: setObsolete
methods.description: Marks the item as obsolete or not.

methods.name: isProductVirtual
methods.description: Checks if the product is virtual.

methods.name: setProductVirtual
methods.description: Sets whether the product is virtual.
